    <article class="prose">
<h1>perch in CI</h1>
<p class="summary">Scan every pull request with GitHub Actions or GitLab CI.</p>
<h2 id="github-actions">GitHub Actions<a class="anchor" href="#github-actions" aria-label="Link to this section">#</a></h2>
<p>Add your API key as the repository secret <code>PERCH_API_KEY</code>, then commit this as <code>.github/workflows/perch.yml</code>:</p>
<div class="codeblock" data-lang="yaml"><pre><code class="language-yaml"><span class="tok-key">name</span>: perch
<span class="tok-key">on</span>: pull_request

<span class="tok-key">jobs</span>:
<span class="tok-key">  perch</span>:
<span class="tok-key">    runs-on</span>: ubuntu-latest
<span class="tok-key">    steps</span>:
<span class="tok-key">      - uses</span>: actions/checkout@v4
<span class="tok-key">        with</span>:
<span class="tok-key">          fetch-depth</span>: 0
<span class="tok-key">      - uses</span>: actions/setup-node@v4
<span class="tok-key">        with</span>:
<span class="tok-key">          node-version</span>: 22
<span class="tok-key">      - run</span>: npx --yes @lakeday/perch scan --since origin/${{ github.base_ref }}
<span class="tok-key">        env</span>:
<span class="tok-key">          PERCH_API_KEY</span>: ${{ secrets.PERCH_API_KEY }}</code></pre><button type="button" class="copycode" aria-label="Copy code"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><rect x="9" y="9" width="11" height="11" rx="2"/><path d="M5 15V6a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h9"/></svg><span class="said" aria-live="polite"></span></button></div>
<p>A pull request that adds a bug fails the job:</p>
<div class="codeblock" data-lang="console"><pre><code class="language-console"><span class="tok-flag">$ npx --yes @lakeday/perch scan --since origin/main</span>
cart.js
  ID        Line  Severity  Type    Confidence  Problem           Method
  450b87b4    18  P1 (1.4)  defect         <span class="p-mid">76%</span>  bad_state_change  removeItem

✖ 1 problem in 1 file, all failing
shop at commit a97a4f6: 4 methods, read 4
4 requests  13k tokens in / 2k out  $0.0005</code></pre><button type="button" class="copycode" aria-label="Copy code"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><rect x="9" y="9" width="11" height="11" rx="2"/><path d="M5 15V6a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h9"/></svg><span class="said" aria-live="polite"></span></button></div>
<p><code>fetch-depth: 0</code> gives <code>--since</code> the base branch to compare against.</p>
<p>Pull requests from forks get no secrets. To skip them, add this to the job:</p>
<div class="codeblock" data-lang="yaml"><pre><code class="language-yaml"><span class="tok-key">    if</span>: github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository</code></pre><button type="button" class="copycode" aria-label="Copy code"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><rect x="9" y="9" width="11" height="11" rx="2"/><path d="M5 15V6a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h9"/></svg><span class="said" aria-live="polite"></span></button></div>
<h2 id="gitlab-ci">GitLab CI<a class="anchor" href="#gitlab-ci" aria-label="Link to this section">#</a></h2>
<p>Add <code>PERCH_API_KEY</code> as a masked CI/CD variable, then add this job to <code>.gitlab-ci.yml</code>:</p>
<div class="codeblock" data-lang="yaml"><pre><code class="language-yaml"><span class="tok-key">perch</span>:
<span class="tok-key">  image</span>: node:22
<span class="tok-key">  rules</span>:
<span class="tok-key">    - if</span>: $CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE == <span class="tok-string">"merge_request_event"</span>
<span class="tok-key">  variables</span>:
<span class="tok-key">    GIT_DEPTH</span>: 0
<span class="tok-key">  script</span>:
    - git fetch origin $CI_MERGE_REQUEST_TARGET_BRANCH_NAME
    - npx --yes @lakeday/perch scan --since origin/$CI_MERGE_REQUEST_TARGET_BRANCH_NAME</code></pre><button type="button" class="copycode" aria-label="Copy code"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><rect x="9" y="9" width="11" height="11" rx="2"/><path d="M5 15V6a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h9"/></svg><span class="said" aria-live="polite"></span></button></div>
<h2 id="exit-codes">Exit codes<a class="anchor" href="#exit-codes" aria-label="Link to this section">#</a></h2>
<div class="table-scroll"><table><thead><tr><th>Code</th><th></th></tr></thead><tbody>
<tr><td>0</td><td>nothing to act on</td></tr>
<tr><td>1</td><td>perch could not run</td></tr>
<tr><td>2</td><td>the command was typed wrong</td></tr>
<tr><td>3</td><td>perch found something that fails</td></tr>
</tbody></table></div>
<p><code>scan_types</code> in <code>perch.yaml</code> sets which issue types fail the job. <code>perch rules edit &lt;name&gt; --gate false</code> reports a rule
without failing on it.</p>

    </article>

  menu.addEventListener('click', () => {
    const open = sidebar.classList.toggle('open');
    menu.setAttribute('aria-expanded', String(open));
  });

  const copypage = document.querySelector('.copypage');
  const opener = copypage.querySelector('.copypage-open');
  const list = copypage.querySelector('.copypage-menu');
  const show = on => { list.hidden = !on; opener.setAttribute('aria-expanded', String(on)); };

  opener.addEventListener('click', event => { event.stopPropagation(); show(list.hidden); });
  document.addEventListener('click', () => show(false));
  document.addEventListener('keydown', event => { if (event.key === 'Escape') show(false); });
  list.addEventListener('click', event => event.stopPropagation());

  // The copy item is a link to the markdown until the script gets here, so it works either way.
  const copy = list.querySelector('[data-copy]');
  const said = copy.querySelector('span');
  copy.addEventListener('click', async event => {
    event.preventDefault();
    try {
      const response = await fetch(copypage.dataset.md);
      if (!response.ok) throw new Error(String(response.status));
      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(await response.text());
      said.textContent = 'Copied';
    } catch {
      // No clipboard, or it was refused. The item is a link to the markdown, so follow it rather
      // than leave somebody looking at a button that did nothing.
      window.open(copypage.dataset.md, '_blank', 'noopener');
      show(false);
      return;
    }
    setTimeout(() => { said.textContent = 'Copy page'; show(false); }, 1400);
  });

  // A console block is a transcript. Copying it should hand over the commands that were typed,
  // not the prompts and not the output underneath them.
  const typedOnly = (text, lang) => {
    if (lang !== 'console') return text;
    const typed = text.split('\n').filter(line => line.startsWith('$'));
    if (!typed.length) return text;
    return typed.map(line => (line[1] === ' ' ? line.slice(2) : line.slice(1))).join('\n');
  };

  for (const block of document.querySelectorAll('.codeblock')) {
    const button = block.querySelector('.copycode');
    const note = button.querySelector('.said');
    const source = block.querySelector('code');
    button.addEventListener('click', async () => {
      try {
        await navigator.clipboard.writeText(typedOnly(source.textContent.trimEnd(), block.dataset.lang));
        note.textContent = 'Copied';
      } catch {
        // No clipboard, or it was refused. Select the block so the keyboard can still take it.
        const range = document.createRange();
        range.selectNodeContents(source);
        const selection = getSelection();
        selection.removeAllRanges();
        selection.addRange(range);
        note.textContent = 'Press copy';
      }
      setTimeout(() => { note.textContent = ''; }, 1400);
    });
  }
</script>
